package.name: umiusi_sim
package.description: ROS 2 metapackage aggregating the UMIUSI simulation's ROS-only integration packages. The simulator and reinforcement-learning code live in the standalone Python project at the repository root (sim/, rl/) and do NOT depend on ROS 2. This metapackage only covers the thin ROS 2 bridge. See ai/project_spec.yaml and ai/architecture.md.
